release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.7 is a hard visual correction based on real v0.45.6 screenshots. Dashboard content remains untouched. Every other workspace now receives a high-specificity Obsidian Surface Lock that removes giant blue/cyan calendar, table, ledger, account, update and module backgrounds; strips decorative gradients and glows; forces cards, controls, injected modules, top search, shutdown, Owner Console, Tachyon Network, navigation and workspace internals into one black/graphite/white hierarchy; and prevents inline legacy theme backgrounds from repainting those surfaces. All existing features, routes and runtime behavior remain unchanged. The exact final main build passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, CodeQL, Private Core CI, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task browser soak.
